title: Canvas2dAdapter
responsibility: Draw the current player, key and gate state on a native two-dimensional canvas.

inputs.name: Canvas2dAdapter.constructor.canvas
inputs.description: The canvas this adapter paints into, stored unchanged as the readonly canvas property that render and dispose read on every call. The constructor does not check it: when getContext('2d') returns null, render returns without drawing and dispose does nothing.

inputs.name: Canvas2dAdapter.render.run
inputs.description: The run whose state the frame reads: draw2d uses only run.state, reading x and y for the player position, hasKey and doorOpen, and the visible:door, visible:key and visible:player flags. A visible:door, visible:key or visible:player flag hides its item when it is exactly false, and a truthy hasKey also hides the key.

inputs.name: Canvas2dAdapter.render.view
inputs.description: The authored view that selects the scene: when view.world is truthy, the level is drawn from world.width, world.depth and world.objects and view.title is not drawn, otherwise view.title is drawn at x 24, y 32 over the default scene. Only view.world and view.title are read, so id, dimension, style, checkpoints and planning do not change the frame.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

checkpoints.title: Collect the key
checkpoints.description: When the player reaches the key, add it to inventory.

examples.title: Garden lane
examples.style: Top-down floor plan with a green lawn and pale stone walls.

checkpoints.title: Reach the gate
checkpoints.description: Walking up to the gate pad records that the gate was reached.

inputs.name: create2d.canvas
inputs.description: The canvas that create2d passes unchanged to new Canvas2dAdapter(canvas), so the returned frame source paints onto it. create2d does not check it, and when getContext('2d') returns null, render draws nothing and dispose clears nothing.

inputs.name: draw2d.canvas
inputs.description: The canvas that draw2d paints: when getContext('2d') returns null the call returns without drawing, otherwise the frame is sized from canvas.width and canvas.height. After drawing it sets dataset.ready to 'true', and for a view with a world it also sets dataset.dimension to '2d'.

inputs.name: draw2d.run
inputs.description: The run whose state the frame reads: draw2d uses only run.state, reading x and y for the player position, hasKey and doorOpen, and the visible:door, visible:key and visible:player flags. A visible:door, visible:key or visible:player flag hides its item when it is exactly false, and a truthy hasKey also hides the key.

inputs.name: draw2d.view
inputs.description: The authored view that selects the scene: when view.world is truthy, the level is drawn from world.width, world.depth and world.objects and view.title is not drawn, otherwise view.title is drawn at x 24, y 32 over the default scene. Only view.world and view.title are read, so id, dimension, style, checkpoints and planning do not change the frame.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

checkpoints.title: Collect the key
checkpoints.description: When the player reaches the key, add it to inventory.

examples.title: Garden lane
examples.style: Top-down floor plan with a green lawn and pale stone walls.

checkpoints.title: Reach the gate
checkpoints.description: Walking up to the gate pad records that the gate was reached.

outputs.name: Canvas2dAdapter.render
outputs.description: No value is returned; the call paints the current frame onto this.canvas through draw2d, and paints nothing when getContext('2d') returns null.

outputs.name: Canvas2dAdapter.dispose
outputs.description: No value is returned; the call clears the whole canvas with clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height) and does nothing when getContext('2d') returns null, so it releases no other resource.

outputs.name: create2d
outputs.description: A new Canvas2dAdapter for the given canvas, typed as FrameSource and exposing the canvas property plus the render and dispose functions. Each call creates a new adapter and does not check the canvas.

outputs.name: draw2d
outputs.description: No value is returned; the call paints the frame onto the given canvas and returns without drawing when getContext('2d') returns null.
